summary: V2 full E2E testing complete. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (health, auth signup/login/me/duplicate/bad-password, travel search for all 4 services with mode=DEMO, cache+detail, featured destinations, trips save/get, bookings DEMO flow + demo-confirm + fetch, SSE chat with done event). Frontend: full happy path works — Home renders hero/destinations/collections/4 service tabs; Hotels search navigates to /search with 6 result cards; clicking a card opens /detail/:service/:id with Reserve now; Reserve now when unauth redirects to /login; after signup the Reserve now creates a booking, routes to /checkout/:id, filling traveller form and Pay (DEMO) confirms booking and routes to /booking/:id with 'Booking confirmed!'; Dashboard shows the booking; AI Concierge opens, Hindi message 'मुझे गोवा के लिए प्लान चाहिए' streams a full Devanagari reply via SSE. DEMO mode is explicit and expected (Razorpay + Akbar keys intentionally empty).

issues: If user clicks 'Reserve now' twice (once pre-login, then again post-signup redirect), a 'PENDING PAYMENT' booking is left orphaned alongside the real CONFIRMED DEMO one. Consider deduping or deleting pending bookings when a new one is created for the same item within the session.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~630 lines — still fine but approaching the point where auth/travel/bookings/chat should be split into submodules.

/api/travel/detail/{item_id} relies entirely on the frontend posting results to /api/travel/cache first. If a user shares a /detail/:service/:id link in a fresh session, the detail endpoint will 404. Consider server-side caching of searches by (service, dest, dates) hash so detail links are reproducible.

/api/bookings/demo-confirm takes a booking_id with no auth check — any user who knows the id can confirm_demo someone else's pending booking. Low risk in DEMO but should require ownership check or at least match user when authenticated.
/api/trips POST accepts optional_user, so unauthenticated clients can create trips with user_id=None indefinitely (soft DoS). Consider rate-limiting or requiring auth.
chat_stream always inserts into db.chat_messages even on provider failure — fine, but language field stored as 'auto' when auto-detect is used; actual detected language is lost.
test_credentials: Dynamic signup emails used (ui_XXXX@destinoway.com / test1234). Seeded account test@destinoway.com / test1234 also present per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates a fresh test_<uuid>@destinoway.com user, several bookings, trips, and cached search items. No cleanup fixture — safe since prefixed/unique.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V2 DestinoWay is production-grade and passing all requested feature tests. DEMO mode is correct until Akbar + Razorpay keys are provided. When Akbar creds land, re-test /api/travel/search?service=hotels for mode=LIVE and verify akbar_ref is present on items. When Razorpay keys land, verify /api/bookings returns razorpay_order_id and mode=LIVE, and that /api/bookings/verify validates signature. The frontend AIConcierge chat input used selector '[data-testid=chat-input]'; the first assistant 'message' element at index 0 is the greeting bubble, so when asserting replies index properly (user msgs and assistant msgs are interleaved as children of chat-messages).
